name: Herceg Novi in a day
description_md:
Herceg Novi in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights. The day is anchored in Herceg Novi, which is located in ME.

This route features 6 sightseeing stops along the way. Walkers cover 10.7 km of walking between stops. The full day takes about 6.9 hours, which includes the visit time at each stop.
